title: The rest cure
summary: John and the narrator's brother treat her with rest, tonics, air and a prescribed schedule, and forbid her to work or write.
body: The narrator is under a rest cure: phosphates or phosphites, tonics, journeys, air and exercise as her strength allows; she is absolutely forbidden to work or write; a schedule prescription for each hour; a lie-down for an hour after each meal; cod-liver oil, ale, wine and rare meat. The doctors say she has temporary nervous depression with a slight hysterical tendency. Weir Mitchell is the fall's threat.
